control_map.source_behavior: Normal production uses release-v3 full-song.mp3 and seamless-loop.flac via BASE_URL. A development-only local preview override can select /__theme-preview/*.wav.
Mounted in exhibit viewer column. The native button toggles Play/Pause while a source exists and Cancel during load; playback starts only after user action.
Version select chooses full or loop. Loop sets AudioBufferSourceNode.loop=true; changing version stops and resets playback before selection.
Restart clears offset and begins selected item from the start. Natural full-song end reports completion and a subsequent Play starts again.
AbortController supports cancel while loading. Non-OK fetch/decode errors stop playback and show an error with retry instruction; AbortError reports cancellation.
Labeled 0-100 range slider starts at 60%; live output displays selected percentage. Mute toggles gain to zero while preserving slider value.
Visible link text is 'Read the lyrics' and points at public/audio/iron-verdict-v3/lyrics.txt; that text file was directly read and matched the release hash.
Native buttons, select, labeled range input, status role, aria-pressed states, and focus-visible styling are present. Source inspection does not prove actual keyboard usability.
